Reshape and flatten preserve logical C-order element indices. Permute and transpose change which logical coordinate occupies each flat index. Only names in public_constants or the explicitly admitted public-weight interface are bound DSL globals. Names under model.constants are logical graph references, not implicit Python variables. Respect the actual bound scalar/vector contents and the exact logical-to-public scalar matches; p-number order has no semantic role. A single-lane packing mask or a masked reduction coefficient is not an all-lane gain, zero bias or replicated scalar. A logical public tensor still needs its declared coordinate mapping; a uniform tensor does not turn matmul into scalar multiplication.
